journeys.title: Document to generated course and assessment
journeys.description: Preserve the proven upload/reindex/retrieval/course/quiz behavior across connected AI changes.
invariants: Embedding source revision is derived from the original document content SHA-256.
Only the active verified document revision and exact embedding space are retrieved.
Adjacent context overlap is deduplicated without crossing tenant, document or revision boundaries.
Generation persists at least one module, lesson, quiz, question and answer choice.
Course structure and quiz APIs are verified according to their separate response contracts.
Requested language is preserved without asserting exact generated wording.
Source density determines lesson and question ceilings without quota padding.
PDF sections and primary-versus-supporting spreadsheet roles remain source-owned across conversion and planning.
Assessment axes, answer keys and distractor scope remain inside the same source-owned lesson block.
Disposable journey data is removed and no invitation or assignment is emitted.
journeys.dev_gate: Run the application dev gate with a synthetic document and current provider route before production.
journeys.production_gate: Run one bounded disposable document-to-course smoke, verify structure and quizzes, then prove cleanup and zero invitations.
